trans-unit.source: Submit to POST /queues. Nothing is corrected: only Dimension Set records may be created. A header selection cascades to its lines and, for a documentNo selection, to the ledger entries of that document, only where their dimension set equals the header's original set; others are skipped with reason "own dimensions". reason is required when the setup says so (Dimensions.Setup.Get). The previewToken is a hash of the selection, the changes and every row's Dimension Set ID and expires after 30 minutes; above maxRows (default 5000) the call is refused.
